title: Arrival card
text_content: Welcome to Canada. This is your arrival card. Write your family name and given name. Write your passport number. Your flight landed at Pearson Terminal 1. Go to customs with your luggage. An officer will ask for your form. After customs, take a taxi at the gate. Keep your ticket and address for the taxi driver. The welcome desk can help if you are lost.

questions.question: Where did the flight land?
questions.explanation: The card says the flight landed at Pearson Terminal 1.

questions.question: You should go to customs without your luggage.
questions.explanation: The card says go to customs with your luggage.

questions.question: Keep your ticket and ____ for the taxi driver.

cultural_note: Arrival cards are short forms you complete before or just after landing in Canada.

title: Airport signs
text_content: Follow the signs at Pearson. Arrivals is downstairs. Customs is after the luggage belts in the terminal. Gate numbers are on the screens. Taxis wait outside Door 3. The welcome desk is next to the taxi line. Show your passport if an officer asks. Keep your ticket for the train or taxi. Write your new address on the form before you leave the airport.

questions.question: The welcome desk is next to the ____ line.

cultural_note: Canadian airports use clear bilingual signs. Follow Arrivals, then Customs, then ground transport.
